issues.description: The UML in the problem statement (Farm.singFarmSongVerse) indicates a private method (shown with '-' visibility), and the template's Farm.java declares singFarmSongVerse as private (method stub). The solution implementation, however, declares singFarmSongVerse as protected. This visibility difference between template/problem UML and the solution may confuse students about the intended access level of the helper method.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the visibility consistent. Either update the solution to declare singFarmSongVerse as private to match the UML and template, or update the UML/problem statement and template comment to indicate protected (or public) if broader access is intended. Prefer documenting the intended visibility in the problem text so students know which access modifier to use.
